parameters.name: DBNodeId
parameters.description: The ID of the node in the cluster. This parameter can be used to query the performance metrics of PolarProxy on different nodes. The following metrics are supported: PolarProxy_DBConns, PolarProxy_DBQps, and PolarProxy_DBActionOps.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description: The interval at which performance data is collected. Valid values: 5, 30, 60, 600, 1800, 3600, 86400, in seconds.

parameters.name: Key
parameters.description: The performance metrics that you want to query. Separate multiple indicators with commas (,). For more information, see [Performance parameters](~~141787~~).

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ` format. The time must be in UTC.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Special metric. Set the value to tair, which indicates the PolarTair architecture.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb describe-db-proxy-performance --db-cluster-id pc-0000000000000000 --db-endpoint-id pe-0000000000000000 --interval 60 --type tair --key PolarProxy_CpuUsage --start-time 2020-09-23T01:01Z --end-time 2020-09-24T02:08Z --db-node-id pi-0000000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb DescribeDBProxyPerformance --region cn-hangzhou --Type tair --DBEndpointId 'pe-0000000000000000' --EndTime '2020-09-24T02:08Z' --DBClusterId 'pc-0000000000000000' --StartTime '2020-09-23T01:01Z' --DBNodeId 'pi-0000000000000000' --Key PolarProxy_CpuUsage --Interval 60
